changes: operator-live checks anonymous /bff/me once before readiness; any response other than 401 immediately emits existing bff.strict_health.<stage> failure and returns nonzero.
/readyz retries with a 180-second SECONDS deadline, fixed 5-second backoff capped at the deadline, unchanged 5-second connect timeout and 20-second per-request timeout capped to the remaining budget.
Every readiness attempt appends attempt number, HTTP status and UTC timestamp to bff-ready-<stage>-attempts.jsonl in AUDIT_DIR; release evidence already hashes and durably copies these audit files.
The shared verify_bff_identity function applies identically to pre_candidate, pre_switch, post_switch and accepted_final, including alternate target_bff URLs.

acceptance_evidence.503_503_200: Full mocked operator-live deployment recovers at all four stages; each stage audit asserts [503,503,200], [1,2,3] attempt sequence and valid timestamps; release remains accepted with valid durable evidence.
acceptance_evidence.deadline_exhaustion: Actual verify_bff_identity and evidence_append functions run with a virtual sleep clock; each of the four stages exhausts the 180-second budget, limits the final curl to remaining time, and records existing bff.strict_health.<stage> failed event. No production deadline override.
acceptance_evidence.anonymous_fail_closed: HTTP 200, 403, 500 and 000 each fail with exactly one /bff/me call and zero readiness calls, preserving existing strict-health failure event.
